thesis: OTC Markets Group operates regulated U.S. over-the-counter equity markets (OTCQX, OTCQB, OTCID, Pink) and FINRA-member ATS infrastructure (OTC Link, extended-hours trading). **[Fact]** Issuers pay listing and disclosure subscription fees; brokers pay ATS and market-data fees. Revenue is subscription- and market-data-heavy with limited principal risk on core operations. **[Fact]** FY2025 net revenues were **$107.882M** (+12% YoY); diluted EPS **$2.58** (+14%). Q1 2026 net revenues were **$33.842M** (+15% YoY) with diluted EPS **$0.59** (+18%). Roughly **11.86M** diluted shares outstanding.
why_market_wrong: No dated payoff or structural discount. **[Inference]** Niche croupiers rarely re-rate to 15% IRR while growing; at ~$52 the stock trades near ~22× FY25 earnings. **[Inference]** Headline net revenue growth understates core fee growth when transaction pass-through grosses up revenue and expense lines. Return is franchise earnings at price unless regulatory or volume scares create a cyclical entry.
